what: A strip of photo cells in different sizes flows straight and endlessly, one set width in 30s, and the photo inside each cell (enlarged 1.4x) is pushed +80px when the cell touches the strip’s right end and −80px as it leaves the left end, more slowly than the cell, so each cell’s depth is staggered — a strip that flows work-scene photos

options.dur: Seconds for one full set width to pass, default 30
options.range: Px the photo inside a cell shifts sideways, default 80 (right end +80 → left end −80)
options.zoom: Photo scale inside a cell, default 1.4 — so cell edges stay filled even when shifted
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cells (children) — if none, all children of the band. Give each cell a width and height
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Image that slides inside the cell — defaults to the cell’s first child

use: …
note: Duplicates the cells twice more and attaches them with aria-hidden (removed on detach). Pauses when the strip is off screen — the original always runs

from.where: index.html .concept__slider (work scene strip) — original behavior.js .sec02-slider: three copies, moves by rAF at one copy width (cell width + 30px) ÷ 30s, the img inside each cell scale(1.4) · x = 80 − progress × 160 (progress = (window width − cell x) ÷ (window width + cell width))
